items.title: 24.3.3 Reactions of Phenylamine (Aromatic Amine) (phenylamine ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.3.3, with Quick Check 24.4 answered (PDF 124-126). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Phenylamine do types (qism) ke reactions deti hai:

blocks.alt: Phenylamine: Kekule benzene ring aik N atom se juri jis par lone pair aur do H atoms hain. 'sp2 hybridized' wali line se arrows ring ke carbons ki taraf; 'sp2 hybridized' se arrow N ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine mein hybridisation: sp2 ring carbons aur nitrogen atom (kitab ke page 124 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is drawing mein nitrogen ko sp³ hybridized kehti hai. Lekin Figure 24.1 (topic 24.3.1) mein kitab khud kehti hai ke nitrogen planar (hamwar) hai aur us ka lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke π electrons se overlap karta hai; yeh sp² hai, is liye drawing mein sp² likha hai. Ring ke chhe carbons bhi sp² hain. Asal phenylamine mein nitrogen thora sa pyramid jaisa hai (sp² aur sp³ ke beech).
a) Bromine water ke saath reaction

Amino group (–NH₂) ortho-para directing group hai, yaani aane wala electrophile ortho (“o”) aur para (“p”) positions par attack karta hai. Amino group benzene ring ko kaafi reactive bana deta hai, khaas taur par in positions par. Is liye phenylamine ki bromination benzene se tez hoti hai, aur dono ortho aur para positions aik hi reaction mein Br se bhar jati hain. 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine ka white (safaid) precipitate banta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenylamine (NH2 wali ring) + 3Br2 se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (white precipitate), jis ki ring mein oopar NH2 aur dono ortho aur para positions par Br hain, + 3HBr.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki bromination se 2,4,6-tribromophenylamine (kitab ke page 125 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: b) Nitrous acid ke saath reaction aur azo compounds ka banna

Phenylamine primary amine hai, is liye nitrous acid se react kar ke phenyldiazonium salt banati hai. Is reaction ko diazotization kehte hain. Jin organic compounds mein diazonium ion, –N⁺≡N (diazo group), functional group ho, unhein diazo compounds kehte hain. Aliphatic aur aromatic dono primary amines nitrous acid se diazonium salts deti hain. Nitrous acid unstable hai, is liye ise in situ (wahin usi waqt) sodium nitrite aur HCl se banaya jata hai. Mixture ko ice (barf) se 10 °C se neeche rakha jata hai, kyunke diazonium salts unstable hain aur room temperature par bhi toot kar nitrogen gas, N₂, chhor dete hain.

blocks.alt: Teen lines: NaNO2 + HCl se HNO2 + NaCl; phenylamine + HNO2 + HCl, 10 °C se kam, se phenyldiazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + 2H2O; phenyldiazonium chloride + H2O, heat, se phenol + N2 + HCl.
blocks.caption: Phenylamine ki diazotisation aur phenyldiazonium chloride se phenol (kitab ke page 125 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehli line: HNO₂, NaNO₂ aur HCl se usi waqt banta hai. Doosri line: phenylamine 10 °C se neeche phenyldiazonium chloride banati hai. Teesri line: diazonium salt ko paani ke saath garam (Heat) karne par phenol, N₂ aur HCl bante hain.

Alkyl diazonium salts har condition mein bohat unstable hain, is liye inhein isolate (alag) nahi kiya ja sakta. Aryl diazonium salts kam temperature par kaafi stable hain. Aromatic diazo compounds ki yeh extra stability positive charge ke aromatic ring par phail (delocalise ho) jane se aati hai. Benzene diazonium salts bohat se organic compounds banane mein important intermediates (beech mein banne wale compounds) hain.

blocks.alt: Kekule benzene ring N(+) triple bond N se juri, + charge ring se jure nitrogen par.
blocks.caption: Benzene diazonium ion ka structure (kitab ke page 125 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Diazonium compounds ke coupling reactions

Aryl diazonium salts ke bohat activated aromatic compounds, jaise phenols aur amines, ke saath reactions ko coupling reactions kehte hain. In ke products mein –N=N– bond hota hai aur inhein azo compounds kehte hain. Coupling reaction mein positive charge wala diazonium ion electrophile ka kaam karta hai aur phenol ki benzene ring mein para position par lag jata hai.
Phenol ke saath coupling mild (halke) alkaline solution mein hoti hai, aur aromatic amines ke saath mild (halki) acidic conditions mein.

blocks.alt: Do lines mein: benzenediazonium chloride (ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl-) + phenol (ring-OH), arrow ke oopar NaOH, se p-hydroxyazobenzene (orange solid), ring-N=N-ring-OH.
blocks.caption: Benzenediazonium chloride ki phenol se coupling (kitab ke page 126 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Mechanism

blocks.alt: Mechanism: Ph-N=N(+) + phenol (Kekule ring), O ke lone pair aur ring ke pi bonds se aakhri N tak curly arrows; intermediate Ph-N=N-C(H) ring jis mein C=O(+)H, C-H bond se ring mein aur C=O se O par curly arrows; phir H+ nikalne se p-hydroxyazobenzene (azo compound).
blocks.caption: Diazonium ion aur phenol ki coupling ka mechanism (kitab ke page 126 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Step by step: (1) diazonium ion ka aakhri nitrogen positive hai, yeh electrophile hai. (2) Phenol ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein dhakela jata hai aur ring ke π electrons OH ke saamne wale (para) carbon se nitrogen par attack karte hain. (3) Intermediate mein para carbon par N aur H dono hain aur oxygen par positive charge hai. (4) Yeh carbon H⁺ chhorta hai, ring dobara aromatic ho jati hai aur p-hydroxyazobenzene banta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne mechanism ke aakhri arrow par ‘–H’ likha hai; asal mein proton (H⁺) nikalta hai, is liye drawing mein –H⁺ hai.
Dyes ka banna

Coupling reaction se different (alag alag) types ke azo dyes banaye ja sakte hain. p-Dimethylaminoazobenzene ko Butter yellow kehte hain; yeh pehle food (khurak) mein use hota tha, lekin carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wala) hone ki wajah se ab food mein is ka use mana hai.

blocks.alt: Do lines mein: benzenediazonium chloride (Kekule ring) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine (ring-N(CH3)2), arrow ke oopar CH3COOH, se p-dimethylaminoazo benzene (butter yellow), ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Butter yellow ka banna (kitab ke page 126 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Methyl orange acid-base indicator hai aur diazotized sulfanilic acid aur N,N-dimethylphenylamine se is tarah banta hai:

blocks.alt: Do lines mein: NaO3S-ring-N(+) triple bond N Cl- (diazotised sulphanilic acid) + N,N-dimethylphenylamine, arrow ke oopar CH3COOH, se methyl orange, NaO3S-ring-N=N-ring-N(CH3)2, + HCl.
blocks.caption: Methyl orange ka banna (kitab ke page 126 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Diazotised sulphanilic acid ka diazonium ion N,N-dimethylphenylamine ki ring par para position par lagta hai aur dono rings ke beech –N=N– (azo group) banta hai. Methyl orange butter yellow jaisa hi hai, bas is mein aik ring par –SO₃Na group zyada hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne methyl orange ke product mein do nitrogen ke beech teen lines (N≡N) chhapi hain aur naam ‘p-dimethylaminoazo benzene’ likha hai. Dono ghalat hain: azo dye mein N=N (double bond) hota hai, aur ‘p-dimethylaminoazobenzene’ butter yellow ka naam hai. Is liye drawing mein N=N aur naam ‘methyl orange’ hai.

Azo dyes mein azo group (Ph–N=N–Ph) ko chromophore (rang dene wala group) kehte hain. Yahi group dyes ke gehre rang ka responsible (zimmedar) hai, jo yellow aur orange se le kar laal, neele aur hare tak hote hain, is par depend karte hue ke benzene rings par aur kaun se groups lage hain.
Bohat se food colours (khane ke rang) mein aksar azo dyes hote hain.
Quick Check 24.4

blocks.prompt: Azo dyes rangeen compounds hain jo phenylamine ke diazonium salt aur kisi activated benzene ring wale aryl compound ke reaction se bante hain. (i) Phenylamine aur 2-methylphenol se dye kaise banayenge? (ii) Reaction conditions (halaat) ke saath step by step equations likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Step 1 (diazotization): phenylamine ko dilute HCl mein ghol kar 10 °C se neeche NaNO₂ ka solution milayein:
C₆H₅NH₂ + NaNO₂ + 2HCl → C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + NaCl + 2H₂O
Step 2 (coupling): thanda diazonium solution NaOH(aq) mein ghule 2-methylphenol mein milayein:
C₆H₅N₂⁺Cl⁻ + HOC₆H₄CH₃ → C₆H₅–N=N–C₆H₃(CH₃)OH + HCl
Azo group OH ke para position par lagta hai aur rangeen azo dye banta hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Phenylamine + HNO₂ (10 °C se neeche): benzenediazonium chloride; paani ke saath garam karne par phenol + N₂.
Diazonium ion + phenol (alkali) ya aromatic amine (halka acid): azo dyes; –N=N– chromophore hai.
